notes: State government-linked university wholly owned by Yayasan Sarawak. Established 2013 as UCTS, upgraded to full university 2021. Located in Sibu, Sarawak. Offers 34 programmes across 6 schools. 5,003 students (2025). First university in Malaysia to achieve GBI Platinum rating.

fees.notes: Official international fees published per programme at https://uts.edu.my/tuitionfees (fetched 2026-09-18); no single aggregate applies. See individual programme records.
